purpose: Level 2 STRUCTURAL: bounded status-only probe of common events/programme path slugs on the same origin, to check for a first-party listing page before falling back to nav-link discovery.
method: curl -sS -L -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; BandOnTheMapResearch/1.0; +research)' --max-time 15 <url>; status-code-only GET per path (no body retained beyond the status line), unauthenticated, single request per path, no retries.
outcome: None of the common events/programme path slugs resolve on this Wix site; the actual first-party navigation structure had to be discovered from the homepage's own rendered nav links instead (see entertainment-page.json).
